english.title: Aid / abet danger of injury due to vehicle condition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled and procured **(..SPECIFY PERSON USING THE VEHICLE..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ]_
(B)_[trailer drawn by a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ]_

when its condition, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), was such that the use of it involved a danger of injury to any person.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 40A of the Road Traffic Act 1988, section 44(1) of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
aid/abet/counsel/procure the use on a road of a motor vehicle/trailer
when the condition of vehicle involved danger of injury

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See also offence wordings: H74, H76 and H77.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) **(..SPECIFY PERSON USING..) drove a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ]_
(B)_[trailer drawn by a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), when its condition, namely **(..SPECIFY CONDITION..), was such that the use of it involved a danger of injury to a person because **(..SPECIFY CONDITION GIVING RISE TO THE DANGER..). the defendant aided and abetted the use of the vehicle in that **(..SPECIFY ACTION(S)..).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale in any other case.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

dvlacode.description: (Aiding, Abetting, Counselling or Procuring) Causing or likely to cause danger by reason of use of unsuitable vehicle or using a vehicle with parts or accessories (excluding brakes, steering or tyres) in a dangerous condition
